schema.text: Do you use the car to be sure of getting back, even after many hours?

ar.#Do you use the car to be sure of gettin: هل تستخدم السيارة من أجل التأكد من العودة، حتى بعد ساعات طويلة؟

de.#Do you use the car to be sure of gettin: Nutzen Sie das Auto, um sicher zu sein, wieder zurückzukommen, auch nach vielen Stunden?

en.#Do you use the car to be sure of gettin: Do you use the car to be sure of getting back, even after many hours?

fa.#Do you use the car to be sure of gettin: آیا از خودرو استفاده می‌کنید تا مطمئن باشید برمی‌گردید، حتی بعد از چند ساعت؟

fr.#Do you use the car to be sure of gettin: Utilisez-vous la voiture pour avoir la certitude de pouvoir rentrer, même après de nombreuses heures ?

hu.#Do you use the car to be sure of gettin: Használja az autót annak biztosítására, hogy biztosan haza tudjon jutni, akár sok óra után is?

it.#Do you use the car to be sure of gettin: Usi l’auto per essere certo di tornare, anche dopo molte ore?

tr.#Do you use the car to be sure of gettin: Saatler sonra bile geri dönebileceğinizden emin olmak için arabayı kullanıyor musunuz?
